name: Hayase Russian Subs
description: Russian ASS subtitles from Anime365, matched by AniList ID and episode.

adapterUrl.description: Optional CORS-compatible fallback adapter URL. Leave empty to use Anime365 directly.

subtitleProxyUrl.description: Required for Anime365 tracks: HTTPS URL of the bundled Worker /subtitle endpoint. It adds CORS for ASS downloads.

maxResults.description: Maximum number of Russian subtitle tracks returned for one episode.
